title: Audit one mixed P104 root’s common head and both view charges
body:
**The first mixed root of [PR #7756](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7756) keeps one canonical physical head across all sixteen actual visits, and both added views are charged.** The separate audit derives its two coordinate maps, all phase corrections and the per-owner view allocation. **No new kappa** or complete caller acceptance is claimed.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ca2d60ef5866d31b9c46fe11a0accf9a17008156/research/mixed-root-head-audit/PROOF.md), [per-visit and per-owner certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ca2d60ef5866d31b9c46fe11a0accf9a17008156/research/mixed-root-head-audit/RESULT.json), [character-evaluation engine](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ca2d60ef5866d31b9c46fe11a0accf9a17008156/research/mixed-root-head-audit/geometry.py), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ca2d60ef5866d31b9c46fe11a0accf9a17008156/research/mixed-root-head-audit/verify.py), [42 source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ca2d60ef5866d31b9c46fe11a0accf9a17008156/research/mixed-root-head-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ca2d60ef5866d31b9c46fe11a0accf9a17008156/research/mixed-root-head-audit/CREDITS.md).

| Actual visits of mixed root zero | Physical head | Exact entry/return translation | Main-array visits |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Fourteen A contacts at port 0 | 11 | 15 | 56 |
| Two B contacts at port 15 | 81 | 83 | 4 |

The root occupies calls 2 through 17 in the 1,024-call schedule; calls 9 and 10 use the B port. Both view maps are involutions for these actual bases. They restore canonical head `e0` and fix all 128 body axes. All 4,096 central endpoint character checks and 3,072 signed-head checks pass.

The audit reconstructs every native route on all 137 axes. It certifies 128 forward/inverse phase identities through their exact degree-two coefficients. For each identity, values at zero, all single axes and all two-axis characters determine the full polynomial modulo four. This proves the equation for all characters, not only the tested ones. All 64 forward offsets agree with the unchanged source routine.

The sixty owner visits have **120 additional permutations plus 120 additional translations**. The certificate lists every call, owner, side and operation. A projection of all 398,944 emitted records in the bounded 32-call batch confirms the root's sixteen `ENTER,NATIVE,EXIT` triples. The first root has the same visits in the 32- and 1,024-call schedules. This is a view-order check, not a full execution of that program.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/mixed-root-head-audit
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_MIXED_ROOT_HEAD_AUDIT
16 visits; heads 11 and 81; exact translations 15 and 83; all 128 spectators fixed
4096 central endpoint characters; 3072 signed-head characters; 128 native phase identities
60 owner visits; 120 permutations plus 120 translations; both entry and return charged
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Missing entry/return translations, the wrong B head and absent return records fail their bounded controls. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44425532479/job/135229261311) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The unchanged ordinary budget function reproduces its source receipt on retained native counts. Its complete 1,024-call allocation includes 819,200 added permutations and 819,200 added translations. The function uses its conservative ambient-153 map allowance, although this caller has ambient 137. These additional views retain the existing native contact adapters and their charges. This audit does not reprove the per-traversal implementation allowance or the remaining ordinary-service terms.

Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, supplied the [mixed caller proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/MIXED-PROOF.md), [scheduler and emitter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/mixed_caller.py), [geometry](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/mixed_geometry.py) and [ordinary tariff](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/mixed_application.py). The new engine evaluates literal parity expressions and obtains coefficients by finite differences. It derives its translations before calling the retained polynomial routines as cross-checks.

The preserved [source credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/CREDITS.md) and [parent notices](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417/research/p104-parallel-bank-punctures/credits/7726-CREDITS.md) credit Rohan Arun, DreamingOfClouds with Claude assistance, SYLforge, Douglas Colkitt, Clear1nsight, Jerry Chen / CubeJerry and the earlier lineage. All 42 source files, including sixteen predecessor notices, remain byte for byte. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, implementation, verification and writing; Apache-2.0.

The graph constructor, scheduler, binding and emitter remain source dependencies. The full native witness, physical all-column replay, signed root program and numerical grid, full 1,024-call stream, other roots, price gate, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not verified here. All five assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. Separate implementation is not independent human or formal-kernel acceptance.

Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Consumed scientific head: `9e051455757d1cc86b822e52e42e1e1c98ead417`; no unmerged ancestry is asserted.
